entities.summary: Carlota Perez is a British-Venezuelan scholar specialized in technology and socio-economic development. Her research focuses on the concept of techno-economic paradigm shifts and the theory of great surges, a further development of Schumpeter's work on Kondratieff waves. In 2012 she was awarded the Silver Kondratieff Medal by the International N. D. Kondratieff Foundation and in 2021 she was awarded an Honorary Doctorate by Utrecht University.
